_about: v4 Library: the shelf, its covers, Your words, Select and Share

library.title: Library

lede.demo: What you brought in, what you made of it, and what you shared.
lede.live: What you brought in, and your words from every Lesson.

library.wordsOnlyEmpty: Notes you write in a Lesson gather here, each one a tap from the page it was written on.

nothing.search: Nothing on your shelf is called “{{q}}”.
nothing.shared: Nothing shared yet. When a page is ready for others, share it from the page itself.
nothing.reading: Nothing left to read. Everything here is read through.

hint.demoCell: PDF, PPTX or a photo — drop it, or click
hint.demoEmpty: PDF, PPTX or a photo. It becomes a page you can read, ask and remember.
hint.liveCell: A PDF — drop it, or click
hint.liveEmpty: A PDF. It becomes a Lesson only you can see — read it, ask it, practise it.

continue.label: Continue reading {{file}}
continue.eyebrow: Pick up where you left off
continue.eyebrowAt: Pick up where you left off · page {{page}} of {{total}}

confirm.demo: They leave your shelf. You can undo this for a few seconds.
confirm.live_one: Its Lesson goes too, with your progress and practice. Your notes stay. You can undo this for a few seconds — after that it is for good.
confirm.live_other: Their Lessons go too, with your progress and practice. Your notes stay. You can undo this for a few seconds — after that it is for good.

share.title: Share {{file}}
share.description: Choose a Space. What happens next is written below before you confirm.
share.noSpaces: You aren’t in a Space yet. Join or make one, then share from here.

outcome.draft: It becomes a draft Lesson in {{space}}. Only you and editors see it until you publish.
outcome.community: Open Space: it joins the path as a Community Lesson, with your name on it.
outcome.contribution: It arrives as your Contribution, with your name on it. The owner can endorse it into the path.

share.notReady: It can be shared once it’s ready.

takeBackDialog.title: Take {{file}} back to only you?
takeBackDialog.body: It leaves {{space}}. Your page and your words stay.

words.title: Your words
words.lede: Every note and every answer you asked for, each one still attached to its page.
words.placeholder: Write it down while it is fresh…
words.empty: Nothing written yet. Notes you write and answers you ask for gather here.
words.unfiled: Not filed in a Space yet

orphan.title: Needs a new home
orphan.body: The Lesson this was attached to was removed. Your work is safe, and it keeps its likes — but it has nowhere to open until it is given a new home.
